traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Crossosomataceae: leaves usually alternate, rarely opposite; leaves simple; margins dentate or entire; veins pinnate; leaves deciduous; stipules present or absent; plants hermaphrodite or polygamous; ovary superior; floral cup present; stems woody; flowers solitary; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit follicle; stamens 20 to 50 (-100); carpels 1 to 5 (-9). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
